text:
maria.g: Heads up — I'm seeing a small but consistent set of sessions flip from stable -> canary mid-conversation. Cookie is still present (rd-sess) but routing changed.
ben.k: saw the same spike ~09:12 UTC. Canary weight is 10% but observability shows ~24% of requests hitting canary for a short window.
kai.r: looking at proxy logs now. There's a surge of internal probe traffic from canary-prober that wasn't excluded by the split guard. Those probe requests carry `x-rd-probe: 1` and an empty client-id which made hashing fall through to header match.
diane.s: that sounds like the migration bug we discussed — probe_exclude defaulted to false when rewriting the guard config in 2.3.1. The console didn't surface the probe flag so ops couldn't see it.
ben.k: example of the rollout config we had (simplified):
```
route {
  match: header("x-rd-affinity")
  split: { canary: 0.10, stable: 0.90 }
  guard: { min_weight: 0.05, floor: 0.12, probe_exclude: false }
  sticky_ttl: 300
}
```
kai.r: because probe_exclude was false, the prober artificially bumped the canary's apparent traffic. Guard floor (0.12) then prevented autoscaler/redistributor from evening it back; sticky TTL made some sessions stay sticky until their cache decayed, so they flipped when the KV cache TTL refreshed.
samir.t: immediate mitigation: set probe_exclude=true on the routing guard for the region, and roll the proxy config. I pushed a hotfix to the config repo branch `fix/probe-exclude-2134`.
deploy-bot: deploy triggered: proxy-config-rollout/fix-probe-exclude-2134 -> region-usw2 (canary 1/3) :rocket:
diane.s: after the patch we still saw ~3% residual flip — looks like session stickiness keys were regenerated for some clients during the spike. We should add logic to prefer existing cookie->bucket mapping when origin client-id empty.
maria.g: console follow-up: the rollout UI doesn't show 'probe' as a traffic source. Ops couldn't easily correlate the extra weight to our probing fleet. We should add a telemetry dimension `source_type: probe|user|bot` to per-request aggregates.
ben.k: agreed. action items: 1) telemetry label for probe (kai), 2) migration test to ensure probe_exclude defaults preserved (diane), 3) add alert on split_pct / intended_pct > 2x (samir).
kai.r: I'll add the telemetry field and a dashboard card for split delta within the region view. Also adding an ingestion rule to drop probe traffic from split calc by default.
diane.s: I'll add a unit/regression test for the config migration and a small migration to flip any bad guards.
samir.t: filing a quick incident note for postmortem. root cause: migration bug that set probe_exclude=false + probe flood + guard floor + sticky_ttl interplay.
maria.g: thanks all. tagging @diane.s and @kai.r for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
